typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		loadDate as timestamp,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		TRADE_DT as timestamp,
		SETTLEMENT_DT as timestamp,
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR as string,
		EXTNL_REF_ID as string,
		TAG_DT as date,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as decimal(7,0),
		REMAINING_AMT as decimal(15,2),
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		ORIGIN_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		RR_CD as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourceReconControlSource	source(output(
		EFFECTIVEDATE as decimal(38,0),
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BUY_CD as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourcep021ispprod
OLEDBSourceReconControlSource sort(asc(BRANCH_CD, false),asc(ACCOUNT_CD, false),asc(CLIENT_NBR, false),asc(EFFDATE, false)) ~> Sort
OLEDBSourcep021ispprod sort(asc(BRANCH_CD, false),asc(ACCOUNT_CD, false),asc(CLIENT_NBR, false),asc(EFFDATE, false)) ~> Sort1
Sort,Sort1 join(OLEDBSourceReconControlSource@BRANCH_CD == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@BRANCH_CD && OLEDBSourceReconControlSource@ACCOUNT_CD == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@ACCOUNT_CD && OLEDBSourceReconControlSource@CLIENT_NBR == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@CLIENT_NBR && OLEDBSourceReconControlSource@EFFDATE == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@EFFDATE,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		loadDate = loadDate,
		EFFDATE = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@EFFDATE,
		EFFECTIVEDATE = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		CLIENT_NBR = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@CLIENT_NBR,
		BRANCH_CD = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@BRANCH_CD,
		ACCOUNT_CD = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@ACCOUNT_CD,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		TRADE_DT = TRADE_DT,
		SETTLEMENT_DT = SETTLEMENT_DT,
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD = BRANCH_CSTCY_CD,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD = ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD,
		CURRENCY_CD = CURRENCY_CD,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR = TAG_CAGE_NBR,
		EXTNL_REF_ID = EXTNL_REF_ID,
		TAG_DT = TAG_DT,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR = BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR = TAG_DPLCT_NBR,
		REMAINING_AMT = REMAINING_AMT,
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID = TRANS_CONTROL_ID,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD = INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD,
		ORIGIN_CD = ORIGIN_CD,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD = TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD,
		RR_CD = RR_CD,
		PRODUCT = PRODUCT,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin01
MergeJoin01 derive(loadDate = loadDate,
		EFFDATE = EFFDATE,
		EFFECTIVEDATE = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		CLIENT_NBR = CLIENT_NBR,
		BRANCH_CD = BRANCH_CD,
		ACCOUNT_CD = ACCOUNT_CD,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		TRADE_DT = TRADE_DT,
		SETTLEMENT_DT = SETTLEMENT_DT,
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD = BRANCH_CSTCY_CD,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD = ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD,
		CURRENCY_CD = CURRENCY_CD,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR = TAG_CAGE_NBR,
		EXTNL_REF_ID = EXTNL_REF_ID,
		TAG_DT = TAG_DT,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR = BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR = TAG_DPLCT_NBR,
		REMAINING_AMT = REMAINING_AMT,
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID = TRANS_CONTROL_ID,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD = INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD,
		ORIGIN_CD = ORIGIN_CD,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD = TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD,
		RR_CD = RR_CD,
		PRODUCT = PRODUCT,
		PRODUCT_ID = PRODUCT_ID) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive({Copy of EXTNL_REF_ID} = EXTNL_REF_ID,
		{Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD} = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD} = INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD,
		{Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		{Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of BRANCH_CD} = BRANCH_CD,
		{Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR} = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD} = ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD,
		{Copy of BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR} = BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR,
		{Copy of CURRENCY_CD} = CURRENCY_CD,
		{Copy of TAG_CAGE_NBR} = TAG_CAGE_NBR,
		{Copy of RR_CD} = RR_CD,
		{Copy of EFFDATE} = EFFDATE,
		{Copy of TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD} = TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD,
		{Copy of ORIGIN_CD} = ORIGIN_CD,
		{Copy of TRANS_CONTROL_ID} = TRANS_CONTROL_ID,
		{Copy of REMAINING_AMT} = REMAINING_AMT,
		{Copy of TAG_DT} = TAG_DT,
		{Copy of TRADE_DT} = TRADE_DT,
		{Copy of TAG_DPLCT_NBR} = TAG_DPLCT_NBR,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CD} = ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of PRODUCT} = PRODUCT,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = PRODUCT_ID,
		{Copy of BRANCH_CSTCY_CD} = BRANCH_CSTCY_CD,
		{Copy of SETTLEMENT_DT} = SETTLEMENT_DT) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		TRADE_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		REMAINING_AMT as integer,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as integer,
		EFFDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SETTLEMENT_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRODUCT as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR as string,
		RR_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		ORIGIN_CD as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		EXTNL_REF_ID as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR as string,
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		TAG_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADE_DT = {Copy of TRADE_DT},
		REMAINING_AMT = {Copy of REMAINING_AMT},
		CURRENCY_CD = {Copy of CURRENCY_CD},
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD},
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR = {Copy of TAG_DPLCT_NBR},
		EFFDATE = {Copy of EFFDATE},
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD = {Copy of BRANCH_CSTCY_CD},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		SETTLEMENT_DT = {Copy of SETTLEMENT_DT},
		PRODUCT = {Copy of PRODUCT},
		CLIENT_NBR = {Copy of CLIENT_NBR},
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD = {Copy of TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD},
		ACCOUNT_CD = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CD},
		TAG_CAGE_NBR = {Copy of TAG_CAGE_NBR},
		RR_CD = {Copy of RR_CD},
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = {Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD},
		PRODUCT_ID = {Copy of PRODUCT_ID},
		EFFECTIVEDATE = {Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE},
		ORIGIN_CD = {Copy of ORIGIN_CD},
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD = {Copy of INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD},
		EXTNL_REF_ID = {Copy of EXTNL_REF_ID},
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = {Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR},
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR = {Copy of BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR},
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID = {Copy of TRANS_CONTROL_ID},
		BRANCH_CD = {Copy of BRANCH_CD},
		TAG_DT = {Copy of TAG_DT}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
